event_confirmation_note: No company release announcing the 3Q26 date was found: the IR events calendar (https://nu.com/en/investors/news-events/events-calendar/) renders empty and the IR home page only links 2Q26 documents plus a Dec 8-9 Investor Day. The 2026-11-12 after-close date rests on Itau BBA's results calendar as reported by Finsiders (2026-11-03) and Euqueroinvestir (2026-10-29), on GuruFocus (2026-11-11, 'after the market close'), Arincen and Earnings Whispers, and it matches last year's cadence (3Q25 on 2025-11-13, after close, 5pm ET call). One company document is consistent with it: the 2026-10-23 6-K says the departing CTO 'is expected to remain with the Company until November 12, 2026'. It is treated as inside the window but is NOT company-confirmed. If the release comes 11-13 after close, the window misses it.
conviction_note: Nothing company-level and unpriced turned up. The evidence is broker previews that set a low bar (net income about flat QoQ at ~$1.05-1.08bn), sector-wide credit deterioration proxies, a provisioning tailwind in 2Q26 that is unlikely to repeat, and post-election, post-Copom-pause de-risking that has already taken the stock to 3% above its 52-week low with calls bid. The negatives are proxies running against a call-side skew, so p_up sits at 48, barely off the non-result. abs_move is 7.5, a little above the 6.56% straddle: the hunters run small, and 2Q26 moved about +10%; it is held back because the Dec 8-9 Investor Day probably takes the medium-term guide out of this print. The findings sum to -1.3 against a scaled -0.3. The gap is the proxies stacking up in the sum while p_up stays near 50.
bar: 3Q26 consensus EPS $0.22 (GuruFocus 2026-11-11 https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9193530/nu-holdings-nu-set-to-report-q3-earnings-amid-strong-undervaluation-signal ; Benzinga; Earnings Whispers), with $0.23 from Arincen/Chartmill. Revenue consensus $5.73-5.96bn. Broker net income: Itau BBA ~$1.05-1.06bn (roughly flat QoQ, ROE 31%, risk-adjusted NIM 11.9%, cost of risk ~18%, loans +33% FXN) and Safra $1.078bn (+1.5% QoQ, efficiency 20%), per https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/ (2026-11-03). Two-plus agreeing sources, so the bar is usable. Company guide: none, Nu gives no quarterly guidance. 2Q26 actual: net income $1,061.1m, revenue $5,875.7m, ROE 33%, risk-adjusted NIM 12.4%, NPL 90+ 6.9% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1691493/000129281426004222/nupr2q26_6k.htm).
positioning_check: Short interest about 134.6m shares, ~3% of float, 1.7 days to cover, as of the 2026-09-30 settlement (shown as 2026-10-22 on one part of the page), https://equibles.com/stocks/nu/short-interest. Not crowded and no squeeze mechanism. 25d skew is -9.87 vol points (calls dearer than puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.70, ATM IV 110.9%, straddle 6.56%. Tape: 20d -18.7%, 5d +2.0%, -36% from the 52w high, +3.2% above the 52w low, 20d realised vol 68.7%. The option market leans to upside after the election sell-off.

findings.finding: Sell-side previews set a low bar. Itau BBA sees 3Q26 net income of ~R$5.4bn / ~US$1.05-1.06bn, roughly FLAT QoQ against 2Q26's $1,061m, with ROE down to 31% from 33%, and Safra sees $1.078bn (+1.5% QoQ). So the market is holding a no-growth profit quarter, below Nu's recent run of +17% QoQ profit growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2Q26 net income of $1.1bn beat (EPS $0.22 vs $0.20) and the stock rose more than 10% (https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/nubank-dispara-no-pre-mercado-em-ny-apos-lucro-recorde-de-us-11-bilhao-o-que-fez-o-mercado-voltar-a-confiar-no-roxinho-miql/). The baseline's history is built from mis-matched 6-Ks and is unreliable apart from the Aug-13 +9.33%.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar itself is public, so it is priced. What may not be priced is how low it is relative to the trend: the consensus EPS revisions are reported as upward (GuruFocus), which sits uneasily with flat-QoQ broker profit. If the market expected growth, EPS consensus would sit visibly above $0.22, and it does not.
findings.independence: Safra and Itau BBA are two brokers quoted in one article. The Itau BBA $1.06bn figure is confirmed separately at https://euqueroinvestir.com/acoes/nubank-queda-acoes-itau-bba (2026-10-29).

findings.finding: 2Q26 risk-adjusted NIM jumped to 12.4% from 9.5% because cost of credit FELL 9% QoQ to $1.69bn, while NPL 90+ ROSE to 6.9% from 6.5%. Provisions fell as late-stage delinquency rose, which points to a provisioning tailwind unlikely to repeat. Itau BBA already models risk-adjusted NIM down to 11.9%. A rebound in provisions above that would land on the line the stock trades on (credit quality).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 1Q26 and 2Q26 were both judged on credit quality: 2Q26's +10% was explicitly 'o mercado voltar a confiar' after the 15-90 NPL improved. A credit scare is the classic NU downside reaction. No company-documented case on hand with the size of a credit-line miss.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the broker previews already embed a lower risk-adjusted NIM (11.9%). The unpriced part is only the risk that provisions normalise further than 11.9% implies, given NPL 90+ was rising at the time of the QoQ provision decline. If the market priced a bigger credit hit, consensus EPS would have been cut rather than revised up.
findings.independence: Itau BBA's ~18% cost of risk and 11.9% risk-adjusted NIM point the same way (finsidersbrasil 2026-11-03, a different document). The 2Q26 numbers are the company's own.

findings.finding: Brazil's household credit deteriorated through 3Q26. BCB September data, per press coverage, has the household free-credit 90+ default rate at 8.1%, +0.1pp MoM and +1.2pp YoY, at its highest level, with the revolving card rate at 451.7%. Inter's CEO said on 2026-09-25 that delinquency 'deve subir no 3T26', with cards the main pressure. Itau's 3Q26 (2026-11-03), on a higher-income book, showed individual NPLs stable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sector delinquency headlines drove NU's H1-2026 sell-off (-20% in H1 per https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/why-nu-stock-plunged-20-first-half-year). The 2Q26 release beat that fear and the stock rallied.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is public macro data and the stock is near its 52-week low. What would differ if the market had fully priced a card-credit hit at NU: put skew bid. Instead calls are dearer (skew -9.87). So the option market is not positioned for a credit miss, which argues against the size of this finding.
findings.independence: Proxy, not NU's own number. Itau's 3Q26 shows stable individual NPLs, which points the other way for the high-income segment (https://investidor10.com.br/noticias/itau-itub4-supera-r-12-bi-em-lucro-no-3t26-veja-os-destaques-do-balanco-123668/, 2026-11-03). Household default of 6% (a record) for August: https://mercadoeconsumo.com.br/29/09/2026/economia/juros-para-familias-sobem-em-agosto-e-inadimplencia-chega-a-6/

findings.finding: The central bank is preparing rules against 'predatory' card and unsecured credit offers. Governor Galipolo (2026-09-24) called revolving card credit, at 65% default, a design problem and floated limits on active offers, an explicit contracting journey and higher capital for card issuance (Singapore model). Itau BBA (2026-10-29) said NU's card and digital unsecured exposure makes it the most sensitive, with the main obligations in 2027. Management will be asked on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior NU reaction to call commentary on a regulation is on hand. Itau BBA's target cut from $18 to $15 on 2026-10-29 coincided with the stock near $11.97, about where it sits now.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced as a headline. The unpriced part is management's quantification of the impact on the call. If the market had priced a material hit, 2027 consensus would have fallen toward BBA's, which is 19% below consensus.
findings.independence: Itau BBA note as reported at https://euqueroinvestir.com/acoes/nubank-queda-acoes-itau-bba (2026-10-29), a separate source.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is washed out rather than crowded. The stock fell about 17% close to close across the 2026-10-25 Lula runoff, a macro and political shock, not a company-specific one. The Copom paused at 13.75% on 2026-11-04. NU sits 3.2% above its 52-week low and 36% below its high. Short interest is only ~3% of float (1.7 DTC), while the options market pays up for calls (25d skew -9.87).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the H1-2026 drawdown, the 2Q26 print bought +10% when credit held. The baseline also shows a +4.98% move on 2026-09-30 (the Monzo denial 6-K).
findings.why_not_priced: The skew already says upside is paid, so this agrees with the market and is largely priced. It is small, and only says that a no-surprise print meets sellers who have already left. If the drawdown were company-specific, the consensus would have been cut. It was revised up.
findings.independence: Copom pause: https://www.oliberal.com/economia/bc-copom-interrompe-ciclo-de-calibracao-e-mantem-taxa-selic-em-13-75-ao-ano-1.1190560 (2026-11-04). Short interest: https://equibles.com/stocks/nu/short-interest. Skew is from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Expenses are growing faster than revenue on international expansion (Mexico bank launched August 2026, US launch and Nu Global from September). Itau BBA flags this, and Safra models efficiency at 20% against 19.5% in 2Q26 and 17.6% in 1Q26, with opex +7.8% QoQ.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2Q26 efficiency worsening (17.6% to 19.5%) was overlooked when profit beat, and the stock rose 10%.
findings.why_not_priced: Already in the broker numbers, so mostly priced. A worse-than-20% efficiency ratio would be the unpriced part. Nu's own Q2 release attributed part of the rise to timing (real estate and marketing shifted from Q1), so some reversal is possible.
findings.independence: Same Finsiders document as finding 1 (counted once for the bar, separately for opex). US launch per https://nu.com/en/newsroom (Sep 14 2026 videocast).

findings.finding: The CTO (Eric Young) resigned per a 6-K dated 2026-10-23 and leaves on 2026-11-12, the print day. The CEO and the CISO are interim co-leads of Global Platforms, and a permanent search has begun.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The filing went out at 16:34 on 2026-10-23, and its reaction is entangled with the election move. A Simply Wall St headline reads 'up 6.4% after analyst upgrades and tech leadership move'.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for three weeks, so priced. Only a call question on AI and tech continuity remains.

findings.finding: Nubank suspended some crypto deposits and withdrawals in Brazil on 2026-11-06, citing an issue with an external provider, a week after a large Binance hack. Mercado Pago did the same.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and immaterial to revenue. At most a call question on operational risk.

findings.finding: Nu holds its first Investor Day on 2026-12-08/09, per the IR site's Earnings/Investor Day pop-up and calendar entry. Management is therefore likely to keep medium-term targets and pricing or regulatory framing for December rather than this call. That lowers the chance of a guidance-driven move on this print without giving a sign.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nu gives no quarterly guidance, and prior prints traded on credit metrics and profit.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a scale item, not a direction. It argues for abs_move not to be pushed far above the straddle.

findings.finding: A 6-K on 2026-09-30 denied that Nu is pursuing a Monzo transaction and said the capital allocation framework is unchanged. That removes an M&A overhang going into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline records +4.98% for 2026-09-30 amc, the session of this 6-K.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and already reacted to. Filed for completeness.

outside_window.finding: First Investor Day, 2026-12-08/09: the likely venue for medium-term targets and the response to the BCB's over-indebtedness rules.
Main obligations of the BCB over-indebtedness and card-offer rules are expected in 2027 (Itau BBA).

BRL/USD in 3Q26: the dollar rose about 0.23% over the quarter (BRL roughly flat), so no material FX translation effect (https://acritica.net/economia/dolar-fecha-setembro-em-r-517-e-ibovespa-avanca-mais-de-5-no-mes/).

rejected_candidates.candidate: Search snippets describing 'Q3 revenue $4.2bn, net income $782.7m, 127m customers' as current
rejected_candidates.detail: These are 3Q25 figures (2025-11-13), relabelled as recent by search. They are not the 3Q26 bar.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative on sector credit proxies, while the skew (-9.87, calls bid) and a stock sitting 3% above its 52-week low after a political sell-off lean the other way. Because the negatives are proxies against the option market's stated lean, p_up is held at 48.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 / core table (a sign against a strong skew): the provisioning finding went from -0.8 to -0.6 and the sector credit proxy from -0.8 to -0.6, because both run against a -9.87 call-side skew with no reason the option market is wrong. p_up went from 47 to 48.

Lesson 5 (a proxy is filed small, not left out): the sector delinquency finding stays filed but small. The BCB-rules finding was trimmed from -0.5 to -0.4 because it is a regulator statement, not a company number.

The 'asking what the market missed generates pessimism' note: checked the sign balance (7 negative, 2 zero, 2 positive in draft). No positive was manufactured; the shift was carried by the skew trims above.
The 'reaction history built from the wrong events' note: confirmed the baseline history is unusable and sized abs_move on the straddle (6.56) and the 2Q26 +10% move, leaving abs_move at 7.5.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the bar is sourced to two agreeing EPS sources ($0.22) and two brokers' net income. No cap was needed. The Investor Day and the 2027 rules were kept in outside_window.
